title: Learning Where to Simulate: Generative Active Sampling for Online PDE Surrogate Training
abstract: arXiv:2606.09949v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Paper published at NeurIPS 2026. For data-driven PDE surrogates, generalizing across a wide range of initial conditions and physical coefficients requires a training set of numerical simulations that consistently covers the resulting dynamics. Yet uniform sampling of these configuration parameters can leave challenging regimes insufficiently covered, leading to high prediction errors and large error variance in the trained surrogate. To address this sampling imbalance, we introduce the Online Generative Active Sampling (OGAS), which continuously adapts configuration sampling during surrogate training, as an alternative to classical round-based active learning. As the surrogate learns from a stream of simulation data generated online, OGAS trains a fast diffusion model in parallel to sample configuration parameters conditioned on a training difficulty signal, such as loss or uncertainty. translated_title: 学习在何处进行模拟：面向在线PDE代理模型训练的生成式主动采样
translated_abstract: 对于数据驱动的偏微分方程（PDE）代理模型而言，要在广泛的初始条件和物理系数范围内实现泛化，需要一个能够持续覆盖所产生动力学的数值模拟训练集。然而，对这些配置参数进行均匀采样可能导致具有挑战性的参数区间覆盖不足，从而使训练出的代理模型产生较高的预测误差和较大的误差方差。为解决这种采样不平衡问题，我们提出了在线生成式主动采样，它在代理模型训练过程中持续自适应地调整配置采样，作为经典基于轮次主动学习的替代方案。随着代理模型从在线生成的模拟数据流中学习，OGAS并行训练一个快速的扩散模型，以训练难度信号（如损失或不确定性）为条件来采样配置参数。该条件采样器使OGAS能够……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出OGAS方法，通过并行训练一个以损失或不确定性等难度信号为条件的扩散模型，在PDE代理模型在线训练过程中持续自适应地采样更具挑战性的模拟配置参数，以替代传统基于轮次的主动学习，从而提升代理模型在难覆盖区间的预测精度与稳定性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Online Generative Active Sampling (OGAS), which trains a fast diffusion model in parallel conditioned on difficulty signals such as loss or uncertainty to adaptively sample simulation configurations during online PDE surrogate training, serving as an alternative to round-based active learning and improving prediction accuracy in challenging regimes.
